svg.title: COMET and CosMx controlled-perturbation proxy evidence
svg.desc: Fold and crack perturbation Dice plus untouched real-field alert burden for classical, nominal-reference anomaly, and hybrid branches.

g.text: Real-background COMET and CosMx experiments remain proxy evidence
Synthetic fold/crack perturbations were inserted into held-out real fields; natural artifacts were not labeled
